messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: cuda.oom.rate > 0.8 in gpu-pool-us-east-1 (rolling window 30s). PD:INC-20260312-89
Maya: got the page, joining. what's the impact?
pagerduty: Alert fired -> PD Service: gpu-allocs (severity: P1). Escalation: Maya (primary) -> Sam (secondary).
Sam: acked in PD. where is the spike coming from? any model rollout?
Maya: checking deployments... not seeing recent model pushes. running heatmap on pool.
infra-bot: Top pods by alloc failures:
```
pod/model-serving-54b2  -> stderr: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
pod/realtime-embedder-77  -> stderr: cuMemAlloc: out of memory
pod/async-reranker-21    -> repeated OOMs, restart loops
```
Leo: that looks like a KV cache prefetch storm again. Seen similar at 4314123456. Could be prefetch misconfig.
Jia: Customers: a small set of calls returned 500 (memory error) and some requests hit fallback to smaller model. Telemetry shows latency spike + error rate up by 12%.
Maya: immediate mitigation: drain the most-failing nodes, and set pool prefetch throttle. I'm going to run `poolctl drain --node gpu-node-17 --reason \"oom-spike\"`
Sam: +1. Also set autoscaler to conservative: `redwood-scale set gpu-pool-us-east-1 --min 2 --max 20 --burst 0` while we triage.
infra-bot: Executed: `poolctl drain gpu-node-17` (started). Node cordon: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17`
incident-bot: PD Note added: "draining gpu-node-17, throttling prefetch, monitoring for drop in OOMs"
Leo: adding a temporary KV cache limit: `KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT=64` in the env for embedder pods. Rolling restart targeted to pods with repeated failures.
Jia: tagging impacted customers in the incident: customer-slug: skyforge, beacon-ai — they're seeing degraded QPS. Notifying account reps.
Maya: logs from the evicted node (snippet):
```
[03:12:45] runtime: allocating 1.2G for attention cache
[03:12:45] error: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory (cuda error 2)
[03:12:46] prefetcher: queue length 2048, inflight 512
[03:12:47] evictor: reclaim 0 bytes, fragmentation high
```
Sam: that fragmentation line is telling — maybe driver-level fragmentation plus aggressive prefetch. Can we toggle `prefetch.batch_size=8`?
Maya: doing that now. patching config on stage then prod. `configctl set gpu-pool-us-east-1 prefetch.batch_size 8` -> applied.
infra-bot: Rolling restart targeted to 6 pods in transit; 2 pods restarted so far.
Jia: error rate dropped to +3% over baseline. Fallbacks still happening but fewer.
Leo: sent a hotfix to the KV prefetcher to respect memory headroom. Will push to prod if mitigations don't hold.
Maya: PD: Updating incident status: Mitigations applied (drain, throttle, restart). Observed OOM events reduced from ~12/s to ~1/s in the last 60s.
pagerduty: PD incident INC-20260312-89 updated: acknowledges and mitigation notes added.
Sam: Should we reroute traffic away from us-east region while we validate kernel-level fragmentation? I can enable regional fallback for latency-sensitive routes.
Maya: yes, enable `route: fallback-region=us-west-2` for routes: /v1/chat/completions (critical), /v1/embeddings (high). Sam, can you flip that?
Sam: flipping now. `routectl set-fallback --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --routes chat,embeddings` -> done. Tests show steady state for critical calls.
Jia: customer-impact update: skyforge saw 34 failing requests during window; they have fallbacks applied so no data loss. Account notified with status update.
Leo: monitoring heap metrics — fragmentation still elevated, but stable. Candidate next steps: schedule host reboot for gpu-node-17 during maintenance window, and add a memory compaction shim to prefetcher.
Maya: agree. For now keep autoscaler conservative and leave KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT until we validate hotfix.
infra-bot: PD note: set severity to P1 -> mitigated, oncall monitoring.
incident-bot: Pager auto-escalation suppressed (condition cleared). Continued monitoring for 15m.
night-oncall: I'm taking handoff in 20m. If things re-spike, wake me (PD).
Maya: handing off to night-oncall. Summary: OOM surge due to aggressive prefetch + fragmentation; drained node-17, throttled prefetch, rolled restarts, enabled regional fallback, customer notifications sent. Keep watch; reopen if OOMs > 5/s.
Sam: leaving socket open on the PD thread, will check heartbeats.
Jia: closing loop with customers, will file post-incident email template.
Leo: making an ops ticket: OPP-2026-091 to run mem-compaction tests and long-term fix for prefetcher.
Maya: resolving Slack thread for now. If anyone sees error rate >5% ping here and PD. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Thread closed by Maya (acknowledged).
